_note: Necessary conditions for a PRD (J2_OUTPUT=prd). Code checks each one on prd.md after every build; the PRD is workable only when all are met and Audit accepts. "check" names the code check in j2.condition_met(). "severity": "warn" shows the result on the Audit tab and in conditions.json but never blocks workable(); every other condition blocks.

conditions.text: All six sections are present and not empty
Requirement ids are unique and sequential (R1, R2, ...)
No invented facts: every number, email and proper name comes from the charter or the Requester's answers, or sits in an Assumption: line
Every goal has a matching success metric
Every user group named in the charter appears in Requirements or in a "no actions in this version" statement
Each numeric success metric states its measurement window, or says "measurement window not set"
